He really knows his material, and is always available to help.
No Comments

Really cares about students gets really into tangents, and can be hard to follow; some people like this because he thoroughly covers topics: had trouble learning in his class/teaching style really likes his allusions and life lessons: no drinking before exams, no top of the stairs, etc. memorable, inspirational, and enjoyed having as professor
Great professor. I'd say the only real issue you'll have with him is his thick accent, but its not bad once you get used to it.

Dr. Hudait is great. I will say though, make sure you don't make a stupid mistake anywhere on an exam, as sometimes you don't get any credit past that mistake which costed me close to 10% of my class grade. Overall, Hudait is by far the best at tech for physical electronics though. His lectures are always fun too.

Professor Hudait is so funny and I enjoyed attending his lectures. He covers the material thoroughly and well, and you can tell he cares about helping us succeed. My only critique is that his lectures were hard to follow sometimes, but that could have just been because of the material. He is definitely the best professor for this class!

Hudait is a hilarious guy, but I had no idea what was going on in the class most of the time. This maybe have been the fault of the ECE 2214 curriculum and not his teaching style. He does genuinely care about the students and about teaching. His class had the highest average (by far) of all professors teaching ECE 2214 the semester I took it.
Dr. Hudait's class helped me find a job in semiconductor industry.
Dr. Hudait is easily one of best teachers at Tech. So inspirational, amazing, and well respected. Take his class and you won't be disappointed.

Professor Hudait is a great professor. He made MOSFETS easy to understand and taught us tricks to make it easier. He really cares about his students and will help them with any questions they have. He often talks about his time at Intel which is very interesting. He is the best possible ECE 2214 professor, take him at all costs.

I'm fortunate enough to have Hudait for both physical electronics and semi-conductor device foundations. He raised my understanding of micro-electronics to a deeper level and gave me sufficient assistant in studying and preparing for exams. Hudait is just the best on both teaching and grading, he gives at least a B for submitting everything.

Prof. Hudait is one of few profs who's passionate about teaching and one of few profs who understand the industry. He explains how and why concepts are important instead of just reading them out during lectures. His lectures are clear and easy to understand and would like to help you with any questions you have during office hours.

Dr. Hudait is one of the best professors u can get for any microelectronics class. He does care about if you understand the lecture and will help you with homework assignments in detail and giving tips on preparing for exams during office hours. He curves the grade a lot because he doesn't want to fail anyone and want most people to get A/A-.

Realistically, this is going to be a hard class regardless of your prof. However, Dr. Gonzales doesn't make it harder than it needs to be, and his lectures are engaging. The people in my class were all talkative with him, and it helped to foster discussion. Just be wary of the hw and START IT EARLY (it took me 4 hours to do one problem once)

Gonzales is a very nice guy. He is not a great professor though. Derives equations all class, examples are messy, posted notes are very hard to follow, not good handwriting. Tests are hard. Test 2 was not curved even though average was high 60s because "test 1 grades were high." Maybe you will like him but, I cant recommend.

Dr. Gonzales is the best professor I've had at VT. The course is difficult, so you have to every lecture and work all the hw problems, but if you put in the time, you will do well. He makes thermo interesting and is passionate about it.

Dr. Gonzales is as fair as professors get. His quizzes and tests are exactly what you are used to from the homework and he goes over examples in class. He is such a great prof that gives you real world problems to solve and does not just teach the theory. His office hrs are very helpful and he offers a lot of insight into the real world. Super humble prof who is both a great teacher and experienced engineer. Extremely good lectures and always ready to take hard questions. Only complaint is the exams are weighted very heavily.

Outstanding professor, great lectures that are very entertaining. His homework is difficult, but not impossible and helps you learn the material well for the test. On assignments he gives a good amount of partial credit and is not unreasonable with any late assignments. One of the best professors at this school.

Great professor. Lectures were helpful and well-paced. Homeworks were pretty fair and he was very conscious about making sure tests, lectures, and assignments matched up.

For AOE 3154, Dr. Fitzgerald had by far the most helpful lecture slides out of any class I've taken so far. He comes to class well prepared, and teaches with passion. This is my second semester of research with Dr. Fitzgerald. He's a great and understanding guy who wants you to enjoy your work. He will give great feedback and can help you if you ask!
